proofUses.reason: The independent-layer last-exit exploration also controls expected cluster size conditional on the original cluster.
Use the ordered negligibility limit and localization, then Hölder with the stated moment scales; no moment order is substituted for negligibility.
Weight the cluster-extension estimate by the small-scale bad event and divide by the fixed large-scale local-mass lower bound.
Order and separate the sweep radii, then use conditional Harris on fresh independent Poisson increments.
The cutoff criterion supplies moments and negligibility, the soft kernel supplies both row and joining bounds, and the upper bound retains the separate higher-point assumptions.
